task_definition.task_description: I need 2 Sony XM5 headphones and I’m considering the black model, so first check for popular alternatives in the same electronics category. Then use the best recommendation to prepare a Stripe invoice for 2 units sent to user@example.com, place that recommended option on hold, generate the payment invoice, and after that submit the order with a credit card.

user_input.query: Hi, I’m user_001 and I want to buy 2 units of product_id p_sony_xm5_blk in the electronics category. I’m considering the black Sony XM5 headphones, but first please check for popular alternatives in electronics. Then use the best recommendation you find to prepare an invoice for quantity 2 and send it to user@example.com. Please use stripe as the payment_gateway, put that recommended option on hold, generate the payment invoice, and after that submit the order using credit_card as the payment_method.
